limits: Two takes on one DMG do not establish behavior of other units.
Repeatability does not identify the CH3 inactive-bus mechanism or CH4 DAC-off stop/reset/rephase mechanism.
Retrigger hides CH3 sample-index and CH4 LFSR continuation.
Subsample timing estimates are not cycle-exact measurements.
